newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Lisbon stocks to rise further, says Spanish bank.
newsitem.headline: Lisbon stocks to rise further, says Spanish bank.

text.p: Spanish bank Argentaria said foreign investors' recent "discovery" of the Portuguese stock market, which is flourishing thanks to falling interest rates and rosy prospects for Portugal's entry to Economic and Monetary Union, could help push Lisbon shares even higher.

"We believe that the creation of the single currency on the target date, including the participation of Portugal, and further cuts in short-term interest rates, will bring additional interest to the Portuguese market, which will result in further growth," Argentaria said in a report for June-July.
The PSI20 index of 20 leading stocks has risen by nearly 50 percent so far this year.
Lisbon stocks have attracted increasing interest by foreign investors since Morgan Stanley decided to promote the bourse to the status of a developed market.
